claims.evidence: photo 0 shows LG logo and DirectDrive label on front panel
photo 0 shows matching label sticker on unit

claims.claim: Doesn't work, needs repair (sold as scrap)
claims.evidence: no power-on, cycle, or error-code evidence in the photo; seller's own admission cannot be confirmed or contradicted remotely

risks.risk: Unit may not power on at all or have electrical/control board failure
risks.proof: video of plugging in and powering on, showing display and dial response

risks.risk: Drum, seals, bearings or motor may be damaged beyond simple repair
risks.proof: video of drum manually spun and door seal close-up, plus any teardown photos
risks.if_unproven: priced as scrap/parts, not repairable unit

risks.risk: Water damage or corrosion from stains/marks on front panel
risks.proof: close-up photos of stain areas and rear panel for rust/corrosion
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming possible internal corrosion, worst case

risks.risk: Missing hoses, power cord quality, or accessories affecting resale/repair cost
risks.proof: photo of all included accessories laid out, plus close-up of power cord and plug
risks.if_unproven: priced as incomplete, buyer must source accessories

risks.proof: photo of rating plate showing voltage/frequency spec
risks.if_unproven: priced assuming compatibility unverified, added risk discount

risks.risk: Age and usage history unknown, affecting remaining component life
risks.proof: photo of manufacture date label or purchase receipt
risks.if_unproven: priced as old/high-usage unit, worst case depreciation

proof_requests: Video of unit plugged in attempting to power on
Close-up of rating/serial plate showing voltage and manufacture date
Photos of drum interior, door seal, and rear panel (hoses, ports)
Photo of any included accessories (hoses, manual, pedestal drawer contents)
response.reason: The witness confirms the item is an LG DirectDrive 6/3kg washer-dryer combo, and the seller's own claim of non-working/scrap condition aligns with pricing it at worst case as a non-functional unit pending any proof of repairability.
